issues.detail: The Greek 'μαλιστα' (malista) is an interjection/adverb meaning 'well', 'indeed', or 'very well', not 'nhất là' (especially/above all). The Vietnamese translation treats it as a comparative emphasis.
The Vietnamese adds 'vua' (king) which does not appear in the Greek text. While contextually implied by the address, it is an addition to the source text.
